answer:
The name now shows once at the top of your Habit tracker app. There was a fixed title above the app's own title, so I removed the fixed one.

While I was in there, I made the weekday letters in the history grid larger. I also made the check circles bigger, so they're easier to tap on a phone. The final check found no remaining issues.
